title: DemandForecastInput
description: Input payload for next-hour EV demand forecasting conforming to Person 2 - Person 5 interface.

timestamp.description: Target hour for prediction in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2022-01-01T14:00:00')

energy_lag_1h.description: Total energy delivered in the previous hour (t)

energy_lag_24h.description: Total energy delivered at the same hour yesterday (t-23)

energy_lag_168h.description: Total energy delivered at the same hour last week (t-167)

sessions_lag_1h.description: Charging sessions count in the previous hour (t)

sessions_lag_24h.description: Charging sessions count at the same hour yesterday (t-23)

sessions_lag_168h.description: Charging sessions count at the same hour last week (t-167)

energy_rolling_mean_24h.description: Rolling mean of energy over the past 24 hours

sessions_rolling_mean_24h.description: Rolling mean of sessions over the past 24 hours

temp_c.description: Forecasted or current ambient temperature in Celsius

history.description: Alternative raw recent historical hourly series (at least 24-168 records)
